description: What things are worth on a chain: token USD prices (the Uniswap gateway's map; the native token, address zero, priced as the chain's WETH), the gas price, and the typical USD cost of each operator operation at it (recenter, move, allocate, reinvest, claim). For weighing whether an operation pays before simulating it — a simulation's own gas estimate is better once there is one. `tokens` narrows the map and lists the ones it cannot price; `derived` names known stablecoins the gateway left unpriced, priced from a stablecoin they are pooled with; `stale` marks a copy served while a refresh fails.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 42161 for Arbitrum One

tokens.description: Token addresses to price; all known when omitted

name: get_prices
title: USD prices and gas cost
